extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology: this paper provides computational AMP-screening rationale, phenotypic antimicrobial activity, and HaCaT counter-screening, but no direct molecular mechanism assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Candidate peptides were prioritized by physicochemical, aggregation, similarity, and AMP classifier filters before synthesis.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: 15 synthetic P. bremeri candidate peptides; final active candidates TPS-029, TPS-032, TPS-035
mechanism_claims.limitations: Computational screening is not direct antimicrobial mechanism evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Broth microdilution supports phenotype-level antibacterial/antifungal activity for TPS-029, TPS-032, and TPS-035 against selected microbial targets.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MIC activity does not identify membrane disruption, nucleic-acid binding, immune modulation, or another direct molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: HaCaT MTT assay was used as a mammalian-cell counter-screen for the three active peptides.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The local figure supports qualitative cytotoxicity trends but not exact per-point numeric toxicity values.
